pages.quiz:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #14 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How is "z" pronounced in "Zahl"? (1 mark)
   A. like sh
   B. like English z
   C. like s
   D. like ts

2. How is the letter A named in German? (1 mark)
   A. eff
   B. pay
   C. yot
   D. ah

3. What does "die Geschwister" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. brother
   B. brothers and sisters
   C. aunt
   D. daughter

4. What does "die Tante" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. aunt
   B. sister
   C. daughter
   D. family

5. What does "die Toilette" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bedroom
   B. lamp
   C. toilet
   D. shower

6. Which little word goes with the noun "Kühlschrank"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. der
   D. den

7. Which German word means "yesterday"? (time) (1 mark)
   A. heute
   B. jetzt
   C. morgen
   D. gestern

8. What is the plural of "das Buch"? (1 mark)
   A. die Bücher
   B. die Buchs
   C. die Buchen
   D. die Buche

9. Which little word goes with the noun "Geschenk"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. das
   C. die
   D. der

10. Which German word is the number 7? (1 mark)
   A. neun
   B. sieben
   C. achtzehn
   D. acht

11. What does "zusammen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. never
   B. later
   C. together
   D. always

12. What does "März" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. September
   B. August
   C. March
   D. July

13. Which little word goes with the noun "Kartoffel"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. die
   C. den
   D. der

14. Which food group does "die Kartoffel" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. die Getränke
   B. das Gemüse
   C. das Obst
   D. das Fleisch

15. What does "der Fuß" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. shoulder
   B. arm
   C. foot
   D. eye

16. What does "die Nase" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. hand
   B. nose
   C. head
   D. hair

17. Which little word goes with the noun "Regenbogen"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. der
   D. den

18. What does "das Wetter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. rain
   B. snow
   C. weather
   D. fog

19. What does "hinter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. in front of
   B. behind
   C. under
   D. next to

20. What does "auf" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. under
   B. between
   C. in front of
   D. on

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write three steps you follow to understand a German text. (3 marks)

22. Explain what the colon, the question mark and the exclamation mark tell us when reading aloud. (3 marks)

23. Write three German sentences describing a member of your family. (3 marks)

24. Write these numbers in German: 4, 9, 12. (3 marks)

25. Spell the name "Zawadi" using German letter names. (3 marks)

26. Write these numbers in German: 5, 8, 13. (3 marks)

27. Name the three umlaut letters and the special letter ß. (2 marks)

28. Explain how your voice should change for a question mark and for a full stop. (2 marks)

29. Read: "Mein Vater heißt Juma. Er ist groß und nett." Write three facts from the text in English. (3 marks)

30. Write a sentence in German that tells in which month your birthday is. (2 marks)

31. Write the plural of Auge, Hand and Zahn in German. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #14 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — like ts
   German z sounds like ts.

2. D — ah
   In German the letter A is called ah.

3. B — brothers and sisters
   die Geschwister means brothers and sisters.

4. A — aunt
   die Tante means aunt.

5. C — toilet
   die Toilette means toilet.

6. C — der
   It is der Kühlschrank, so the little word is der.

7. D — gestern
   yesterday in German is gestern.

8. A — die Bücher
   The plural of das Buch is die Bücher.

9. B — das
   It is das Geschenk, so the little word is das.

10. B — sieben
   7 in German is sieben.

11. C — together
   zusammen means together.

12. C — March
   März means March.

13. B — die
   It is die Kartoffel, so the little word is die.

14. B — das Gemüse
   die Kartoffel belongs to das Gemüse.

15. C — foot
   der Fuß means foot.

16. B — nose
   die Nase means nose.

17. C — der
   It is der Regenbogen, so the little word is der.

18. C — weather
   das Wetter means weather.

19. B — behind
   hinter means behind.

20. D — on
   auf means on.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Look at the title and pictures; read once for the gist; read again for details and answers.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: The colon announces a list or speech, the question mark tells us to raise the voice and the exclamation mark shows strong feeling.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each mark.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Meine Mutter heißt Neema. Sie ist jung. Sie ist lustig.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence with capital letters and full stops.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: vier, neun, zwölf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Z (tset), A (ah), W (vay), A (ah), D (day), I (ee).
   Working / marking points: 3 marks if all letter names are correct; 2 marks for four or five; 1 mark for two or three.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: fünf, acht, dreizehn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: ä, ö, ü and ß (Eszett).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the three umlauts and 1 mark for ß.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: It goes up at a question mark and down at a full stop.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: The father is called Juma. He is tall. He is kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fact.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich habe im Mai Geburtstag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the pattern, 1 mark for a correctly spelled month.

31. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Augen, die Hände, die Zähne.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct plural.
